LAW AND MOTION, 301, DEFENDANTS' MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT. THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANTS RAYMOND SIU LUNG TUNG, LILY TSE YUEN TUNG, LORRAINE TUNG, ARNOLD TUNG'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT OR, IN THE ALTERNATIVE, SUMMARY ADJUDICATION IS DENIED. PLAINTIFFS RAISE A TRIABLE ISSUE OF FACT AS TO WHETHER DEFENDANTS MOVED INTO AND MAINTAINED THE SAN FRANCISCO HOUSE AS THEIR PRINCIPAL RESIDENCE FOR THE RELEVANT TIME PERIOD. DEFENDANTS HAVE NOT SHOWN THAT PLAINTIFFS CANNOT PROVE AN ENTITLEMENT TO REFUND OF DEPOSIT OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO PREPARE A FORM OF ORDER PURSUANT TO SECTION CCP 437(C)G.
